title: 2.1.8 Chain Three Branches
description: Write an else if chain with at least three branches. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice for 'Several Conditions: else if', book 2.1.4

steps.title: Declare a battery level
steps.instructions: Create a variable called batteryPercent and set it to a number from 0 to 100.

steps.title: Chain at least three branches
steps.instructions: Write an if / else if / else if / else chain that logs a status: below 20 logs 'Low battery', below 50 logs 'Battery ok', below 90 logs 'Battery good', and anything else logs 'Battery full'. This chain uses < comparisons, not >=, so check the lowest cutoff first -- the opposite order from the grade example, which uses >= and checks the highest cutoff first.

requirements.title: below 20 logs Low battery
requirements.description: if condition checks batteryPercent < 20 and logs a message containing 'Low battery'

requirements.title: below 50 logs Battery ok
requirements.description: else if condition checks batteryPercent < 50 and logs a message containing 'Battery ok'

requirements.title: below 90 logs Battery good
requirements.description: else if condition checks batteryPercent < 90 and logs a message containing 'Battery good'

requirements.title: final else logs Battery full
requirements.description: the closing else branch logs a message containing 'Battery full'
